name: Goal Plan Builder
oneLiner: A 60-second quiz matches GTA shoppers to one of six goal plans built from real Meal Butler meals, sold as a skip-anytime subscription (weekly, every 2 weeks or a monthly Freezer Fill) with 10% off.
headline: Standing orders turn one-off Meal Butler carts into predictable, recurring revenue at about 40% gross margin, using meals J&W already cooks.
focus: Quiz-led goal plans on a skip-anytime subscription
mechanism: J&W adds a quiz and six goal plans (Lean, Lean Bulk, Athlete, Protein & Greens, GLP-1 Companion, Busy Family) built only from current Meal Butler items. Examples: the Jerk Chicken pre-set at $12.99 (4oz); Chicken Breast Souvlaki 6oz at $6.93 with 6oz white basmati at $2.31 and broccoli at $1.39; 4oz salmon at $7.99; Egg White Bites at $5.25; Lemon Chicken Rice Soup at $8.99. Each box (10 to 40 meals) is priced as the sum of those real items, then 10% off on subscription. That lands at $7.30 a meal (GLP-1 Companion, 14 meals) to $13.02 (Lean Bulk), against about $16 to $27 for GTA goal plans. Customers choose weekly, every 2 weeks or a monthly Freezer Fill (possible only because J&W freezes its meals in vacuum packs), and can skip, swap or pause until Sunday night. If they change nothing, a Butcher's Pick box ships. A household box puts several people's plans in one delivery with one fee, and every box rides the existing Tue to Fri routes or free pickup at Brimley Rd.

modelledOn.name: Power Kitchen
modelledOn.short: Quiz-matched goal meal plans on a skip-anytime subscription
modelledOn.what: Family-owned, bootstrapped GTA meal-prep company (46 Hollinger Rd, about 10 km from Brimley Rd). It sells eight goal plans (Power, Pro Athlete, GLP-1 Support, Low Carb, Clean Bulking, Keto, Lean Muscle, Vegan) through a plan-matching quiz. The subscription auto-renews and can be skipped, paused or edited before a hard cut-off. It also runs a sticky custom-meal builder, a one-month trial, a prepaid 6-week program, rewards, referrals and an ambassador program.
modelledOn.proof: Verified Oct 16 2026: goal boxes list at $16.22-$36.95 a meal (Power and Lean Muscle $17.85-$23.95; GLP-1 Support $21.76-$27.96). Subscribe discount 5% plus 5% credit. One-Month Trial $365-$535 for 20 meals. 4.7 stars from 564 Google reviews. 185 SKUs, all updated Oct 16 2026. Own fleet to about 40 cities on Sunday and Wednesday. Stack includes Klaviyo, Triple Whale and Sezzle. Revenue not published; estimate about C$3-7M a year (low confidence).
modelledOn.jwEdge: J&W is its own Ontario-inspected butcher (plant since 2008, family butchers since 1995). Recipes are salt and sugar free with no added oils. Plan meals cost $7.30-$13.02 with Subscribe & Save, roughly 25-45% less per like-for-like meal (est.). Frozen vacuum packs allow a monthly Freezer Fill and long-haul Ontario routes that fresh rivals cannot serve. A household box covers several people in one order, which Power Kitchen cannot do. Credits apply automatically. J&W also has bigger social proof: 4.8 stars from 611 Google reviews and 30K Instagram followers.

mathYear1: Subscribers ramp from 0 (Nov 2026 build month) to 251 by Oct 2027. New subscribers: Dec 25, Jan 60, Feb 45, Mar 35, Apr 35, May 30, Jun 25, Jul 25, Aug 30, Sep 40, Oct 40 = 390, with 9% monthly churn. That gives 1,675 subscriber-months (avg 140 active) x $243.75 a month ($125 box after 10% off x 26 deliveries x 0.9 not skipped / 12) = $408K. Add 220 one-off plan boxes x $135 = $30K. Gross $438K x 0.8 incrementality = $350K added revenue (mid). Low: 245 new, 12% churn, $120 box, x0.75 = ~$175K. High: 555 new, 7% churn, $130 box, x0.85 = ~$580K.
mathRunRate: Year 2 (Nov 2027-Oct 2028): start with 251 active, add 35 a month, churn 8.5%. Average 312 active x $2,925 a year ($125 x 26 x 0.9) = $914K, plus 240 one-off boxes x $135 = $32K. Gross $946K x 0.8 incrementality = ~$757K a year added revenue. Low ~$380K (25 adds/month, 11% churn); high ~$1.2M (45 adds/month, 7.5% churn; needs a second packing shift).
mathNotes: Plan prices are sums of J&W's real Oct 16 2026 online prices. Example: Lean Bulk 10 meals = $144.65 one-off, $130.18 with 10% Subscribe & Save ($13.02 a meal).
Revenue counts only subscribers who were not already weekly Meal Butler buyers. The 10% given to existing buyers who switch (~60 people, ~$13K in year 1) is counted as a cost, not as revenue.
Gross margin 40% after the 10% discount (model-assumptions.md). Year 1 mid: $350K x 40% = $140K gross profit, minus ~$89K all-in JW costs = ~$51K contribution before Minastech's fee.
Year 2: $757K x 40% = $303K gross profit, minus ~$120K running costs = ~$183K contribution.
Cross-check: market-benchmarks.md section 11 says ~320 active every-2-weeks subscribers at $120 is about $1M gross. This play's year-2 average of 312 at $125 with 10% skips gives $914K gross.
Volume: ~68 extra boxes a week (~850 meals) on average in year 1, ~146 a week (~1,800 meals) in year 2. Today J&W runs an estimated 60-160 delivery orders a week, so plant capacity must be confirmed.
Delivery runs on existing routes. The customer pays the $20-$35 route fee, which covers an owned-route stop at $8-$14. No new route days.
Year 1 is +14% on the ~$2.5M mid baseline; run-rate is +30%. Both are within the typical range for one play.

agentNeeds.name: Macro Butler (plan matcher)
agentNeeds.job: Scores quiz answers into one of six plans, sets box size and cadence, splits a household into profiles, and writes a two-line 'why this plan' note from owner-approved templates. Routes medical, allergy or eating-disorder signals to a person. Chat-based personal plans hand off to the AI Coach (Play 6).
agentNeeds.onScreen: Quiz result card: 'Why we picked Lean Bulk for you', labelled 'Drafted by Macro Butler from your answers', plus the household split.

agentNeeds.name: Nutrition Data Agent
agentNeeds.job: Computes est. macros for the ~31 plan SKUs from recipes, cooked yields and Health Canada CNF values. Writes them to Shopify metafields and queues each panel for a nutritionist's sign-off. Flags regulated claim wording (high protein, low carb, GLP-1).
agentNeeds.onScreen: 'est.' macro chips on every plan card and meal row; team tile 'Macro sign-off: 9 of 31 plan SKUs verified'.

agentNeeds.name: Butcher's Pick Menu Agent
agentNeeds.job: Drafts next week's default box for each plan within stock, par levels and margin, and rotates chicken flavours so subscribers don't get bored. The owner approves before the Sunday cut-off.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team approval card: 'Week of Mar 29: Lean box swaps the Tilapia pre-set for the Haddock plate (tilapia 2 cases below par). Margin +$0.40 a box.'

agentNeeds.name: Subscription & Reorder Agent
agentNeeds.job: Sends Saturday SMS and email reminders before the Sunday cut-off. Handles OK, SKIP, SWAP and PAUSE replies in plain language. Proposes cancel-save offers within owner-set limits and follows up failed payments. Checks CASL consent.
agentNeeds.onScreen: SMS preview in My Plan, the cancel-save modal, and team approvals for 3 save offers and the Saturday reminder.

agentNeeds.name: Production Forecast Agent
agentNeeds.job: After the Sunday cut-off, turns subscription lines into Monday's cook, portion and pack sheet, box counts by route day, and the raw-material purchase list.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team 'Monday prep sheet' table (portions by SKU) and the route-impact panel (boxes by route day).

agentNeeds.name: Lifecycle Marketing Agent
agentNeeds.job: Drafts quiz-abandon emails, a welcome series for each plan, the January 6-Week Reset campaign and the switch campaign for displaced Goodfood and LiveFit customers. The owner approves every send.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team campaign drafts awaiting approval, including one GLP-1 email flagged for labelling review.

agentNeeds.name: Review & Reputation Agent
agentNeeds.job: Asks subscribers for a product and Google review after their second box and drafts replies. A person approves every reply to a 1-3 star review. No undisclosed incentives.
agentNeeds.onScreen: Team queue: 2 reply drafts for new Google reviews.

assumptions: Average subscription box is $125 after 10% off ($139 before). 26 scheduled deliveries a year (every-2-weeks equivalent across the weekly, every-2-weeks and monthly mix), 10% skipped, so $2,925 a year per active subscriber.
390 new subscribers in year 1 (Dec-Oct). None in November, the build month. Existing weekly Meal Butler buyers who switch are not counted as revenue.
Monthly churn is 9% in year 1 and 8.5% in year 2 (Eightx: replenishment 5-8%, meal kits 8-15%).
220 one-off plan boxes in year 1 and 240 in year 2, at $135.
Gross margin 40% after the 10% Subscribe & Save discount (model-assumptions.md).
About 45% of new subscribers come from paid ads at about $85 CAC. The rest come from Instagram (30K), email, the store counter and referrals.
Delivery uses existing routes at current fees ($20-$35, $100 minimum) or free pickup. J&W's existing free-delivery-from-$200 rule needs confirming.
The plant can absorb ~850 extra meals a week in year 1 and ~1,800 in year 2 (to confirm with J&W).
Prices are J&W's online prices on Oct 16 2026. Macros are estimates until a nutritionist verifies them.
risks: Claims: J&W shows no nutrition panels, and 'high protein', 'low carb' and GLP-1 wording are regulated or sensitive under Canada's Food and Drug Regulations. Mitigation: show 'est.' on macros until a nutritionist signs off, use 'Protein & Greens' instead of 'Low Carb', and get a labelling review before launch.
Discount leakage: existing weekly buyers may move to 10% off (~$13K in year 1). Mitigation: Subscribe & Save applies to plan boxes only, not to à la carte carts.
Kitchen capacity and stockouts on plan SKUs (e.g. tilapia, salmon). Mitigation: Production Forecast Agent par levels, and Butcher's Pick swaps within the plan.

Churn could run above the model (meal kits churn 8-15% a month; 44% of cancellations happen in the first 90 days). Mitigation: skip and pause, monthly Freezer Fill, save offers and failed-payment follow-up. The low case uses 12% churn.
Only one route day per zone, while fresh rivals deliver Sunday and Wednesday. The frozen format makes weekly or monthly delivery enough; $30 express stays for urgent orders.
Overlap with Play 6 (AI Coach) for the same subscribers. Count quiz-led subscribers here and chat-led personal plans in Play 6 only.
Owner-led brand risk (a 2020 Yelp complaint). Front the plans with the Meal Butler team and the product.
Comparative pricing must stay accurate. Quote public price ranges, not a named rival, and recheck each quarter.
who: Meal Butler lead (e.g. Lucas or Tasia), 8-12 h/week on plan menus, AI-draft approvals and subscriber messages. Owner (Bill), about 1 h/week on the Monday digest and offer approvals. Kitchen: one part-time cook/packer from February, 20 h/week rising to 35 h/week by October. Store counter: about 2 h/week for pickup plan boxes. Minastech builds the quiz, plans, subscription setup and agents (fee not counted here).

costs.note: Estimates, excluding Minastech's fee. Setup: nutritionist review of plan rules and ~31 SKUs $2,500; lab analysis of top 8 SKUs $1,600; plan photos and video $1,200; label design and print $800; staff training $900. Year-1 running (Dec-Oct) ~$81.9K (~$7,450 a month): software $6.2K (subscription app ~$200/mo, Klaviyo email+SMS share ~$250/mo, AI tokens ~$100/mo, reviews app $15/mo); paid ads $15K (~175 subscribers x ~$85 CAC); switch and referral credits $6.2K; Meal Butler lead 12 h/wk $13.8K; part-time cook/packer from Feb $25.7K; box labels $2.1K; discount leakage on existing buyers who switch $13K. At year-2 volume, running costs rise to about $10K a month (~$120K a year). Route delivery stays customer-paid ($20-$35) and covers the $8-$14 cost per stop.

prototype.concept: Shows how J&W can sell the meals it already cooks as goal plans on a subscription, the way Power Kitchen does, but in J&W's voice and at J&W's prices. A shopper answers an 8-step quiz and gets a named plan with est. macros and a real price per meal, built from current Meal Butler SKUs. They subscribe weekly, every 2 weeks or as a monthly Freezer Fill, then manage it in a My Plan portal (skip, swap, pause, cancel with a save offer). The JW team view shows subscribers, the Monday prep sheet, route impact and AI-agent drafts waiting for approval.
prototype.wow: Pick a goal and a priced, macro-counted box of real J&W meals assembles itself as a stack of kraft freezer bags in the sticky bag. Flip 'Every 2 weeks' to 'Monthly Freezer Fill' and the stack grows to a month of meals, the price per meal holds, and 'Route fees a month' drops from 2 x $20 to 1 x $20.

design.inspiredBy: Power Kitchen's structure: thin cut-off announcement bar, quiz card with a step tracker and encouraging notes, goal-plan cards with macro chips and a plan accent colour, a sticky builder bag with a 'meals chosen' counter, and a dark rounded trust panel. Rebuilt in J&W's laurel navy, Meal Butler slate purple and sky blue on a warm kraft-cream ground with a premium serif, plus butcher-heritage cues (kraft paper, vacuum-pack freezer bags).

palette.role: J&W navy: primary buttons, links, logo zone, Lean Bulk accent
Deep ink: headings, cut-off bar, dark trust panel, footer
Meal Butler slate purple: recommended offer card, My Plan header, GLP-1 Companion accent
Sky blue: selected quiz option border, progress tracker, Lean accent (never as text on white)
Sky tint: selected quiz option background, info chips
Kraft tan: freezer-bag stack illustrations, dividers
Butcher red: cut-off countdown and Athlete accent only
Savings green: Subscribe & Save rows, Protein & Greens accent
Amber: Busy Family accent and 'Concept' tags (dark text on light amber tint)

design.layout: Mobile-first single column at 375px; 12-column grid at 1024px+. Quiz is a centred white card (max 720px, 16px radius) with a dot tracker and full-pill options at least 44px tall. Plan cards sit in a 1/2/3-column grid with a 4px left rule in the plan accent. The builder is two panes on desktop with a sticky right-hand bag; on mobile the bag becomes a bottom sheet with a sticky bar ('14 of 14 meals · $182.02'). Freezer Fill and Household are full-width bands; trust is a dark rounded panel. Soft shadows, 12-16px radii, no horizontal scroll.
design.tone: Plain, warm and specific, like the family butcher at the counter. Canadian spelling (fibre, flavour, favourite), short sentences, no hype words, no emoji. 'We' is the J&W kitchen. Every macro says 'est.'; concept items carry an amber 'Concept' tag; GLP-1 copy always says it is food, not medical advice.

Every week · Every 2 weeks (most popular) · Once a month (Freezer Fill) (note: 'Our meals are frozen in vacuum packs, so a month at once works.'). sections.name: FAQ
sections.content: Accordion. 'Are the macros exact?' → 'Not yet. They're estimates from standard nutrition data until our panels are checked by a nutrition professional. We'll mark verified meals.' 'When can I change my box?' → 'Any time before Sunday night for the next week's route. After that, your box is being cooked.' 'Can I skip or pause?' → 'Yes. Skip any delivery or pause for 1 to 8 weeks from My Plan. Skipped weeks are never charged.' 'How do I store and heat the meals?' → 'Keep them frozen and follow the date and heating steps on each bag.' 'Do you deliver to me?' → 'We run weekly routes Tuesday to Friday across the GTA and some of Ontario for $20 to $35, with a $100 minimum. Pickup at Brimley Rd is free.' 'Is the GLP-1 Companion medical advice?' → 'No. It's smaller, protein-first meals. Follow your prescriber's advice.' 'Can I cancel?' → 'Yes, from My Plan, before the Sunday cut-off, with no fee.'

chat.name: Ask the Butler
chat.greeting: Hi, I'm the Butler. I can help you pick a plan, explain Subscribe & Save, or skip a week. What's your goal?
suggestions: How do skip and pause work?
Can my family share one box?
What does a Freezer Fill cost?

rules.reply: Skip any delivery or pause for 1 to 8 weeks from My Plan, any time before Sunday night. Skipped weeks are never charged.
You can cancel from My Plan with no fee before the Sunday cut-off. If it's too much food or too much money, a smaller box or a monthly Freezer Fill might fit better.

The GLP-1 Companion plan has smaller 3–4oz protein portions with fibre-rich sides like quinoa and Brussels sprouts: about 270 kcal and 27g protein a meal (est.). 14 small meals are $102.26 with Subscribe & Save. It's food, not medical advice, so follow your prescriber's guidance.

The quiz above takes about a minute. Quick guide (est. per meal): Lean 337 kcal / 37g protein, Lean Bulk 523 / 54g, Athlete 476 / 44g, Protein & Greens 301 / 46g with about 12g carbs, GLP-1 Companion 272 / 27g, and Busy Family for households.

Every Meal Butler meal is cooked, portioned and flash-frozen in a vacuum-sealed bag, so a monthly Freezer Fill works: one delivery and one route fee a month. Keep the bags frozen and follow the date on each. A Lean Freezer Fill of 20 meals is $197.98 with Subscribe & Save.

A household box puts everyone's plan in one delivery with name tags on the packing list. Example: Lean Bulk for one adult, GLP-1 Companion for another, plus 6 kids' plates, $233.60 every 2 weeks with Subscribe & Save.
Welcome. Tell the quiz which service you used and we'll take $25 off your first subscribed box (concept offer). Plan meals here run $7.30 to $13.02 with Subscribe & Save.

With 10% Subscribe & Save, plan meals are $7.30 to $13.02 each (est. from our current prices). Most boxes run about $100 to $260, depending on plan and size. Route delivery is $20–$35 with a $100 minimum, or free pickup at Brimley Rd.
Swap any meal for another one in your plan until Sunday night. Chicken plates can switch flavour too: Greek Lemon, Korean BBQ, Teriyaki, Arabic 7 Spice or BBQ.
